text: Claude is an AI assistant created by Anthropic, built on a Large Language Model.
It comes in different model versions: smaller models are faster and cheaper for simple tasks, while larger models handle complex reasoning.
You can access Claude through web, desktop, and mobile apps, through Claude Code inside technical projects, or via an API.
In a chat, you ask questions and Claude answers.
As an agent, Claude can take action using tools across multi-step tasks.
To get great results, practice three habits: give the context, state your clear goal, and specify the exact format—such as a short email or a table.
